name: Roundup Biactive®
notes: Knockdown prior to sowing lucerne; do not apply over established lucerne stands.
safetyInformation: Wear protective clothing and avoid drift to waterways.

name: Buttress®
notes: Apply to seedling/established lucerne not under stress. Observe plant-back periods for following crops.
safetyInformation: Avoid spray drift to sensitive species (brassicas, legumes). Use PPE.

name: Raptor®
notes: Apply when lucerne has sufficient leaf area and is actively growing. Avoid application to stressed crops.
safetyInformation: Use PPE; avoid drift to non-target legumes.

name: Spinnaker®
notes: Effective on small, actively growing weeds; residual activity provides extended control.
safetyInformation: Observe plant-back intervals; avoid drift to sensitive crops.

name: Gramoxone®
applicationRate: 1.2–2.4 L/ha depending on target weed size
notes: Use with shielded sprayers between rows of established lucerne to avoid crop contact.
safetyInformation: Highly toxic—strict PPE, follow label and local regulatory restrictions.

name: Diuron 500SC
applicationRate: 1.5–3.0 L/ha pre- or post-emergent per label
notes: Residual activity; avoid sandy soils with low organic matter; watch for crop tolerance.
safetyInformation: Avoid contamination of waterways; follow buffer zones.

name: Velpar®
applicationRate: 0.5–1.0 kg/ha depending on weeds and soil
notes: Check lucerne variety tolerance; effectiveness influenced by soil texture and moisture.
safetyInformation: Potential for leaching; avoid sandy soils and protect waterways.

name: 2,4-DB Amine 500
notes: Use on established lucerne; avoid application during flowering or crop stress.
safetyInformation: Avoid drift to sensitive broadleaf crops; observe re-entry intervals.

name: MCPA Amine 750
applicationRate: 0.5–1.0 L/ha depending on weed and crop stage
notes: Use with care on lucerne; risk of temporary suppression—apply at cooler temps and avoid stress.
safetyInformation: Use PPE; avoid drift to vines, vegetables, ornamentals.
